kewaunee-analytics-detail.alt: Workflow diagram: stakeholder question, validated records, model and definitions, executive reporting.
kewaunee-analytics-detail.caption: Illustrative reporting workflow. No company dashboards, data, or schemas are shown.

one-chaptr-detail.alt: Architecture diagram: tenant configuration, shared codebase with 63 components, typed provider boundary, and a planned InkSoft integration.
one-chaptr-detail.caption: Illustrative platform architecture. The InkSoft integration is planned, not live.

prospectiq-detail.alt: Seven-stage pipeline diagram from CLI input to CSV export, with notes on provenance, observed versus inferred data, and responsible limits.
prospectiq-detail.caption: The pipeline as documented in the project: every stage reads the structured record produced by the stage before it.

nypd-crime-data-analysis-detail.alt: Heatmap of bias motive counts across Pre-COVID, During COVID, and Post-COVID periods, with anti-Jewish incidents highest in every period.
nypd-crime-data-analysis-detail.caption: From the final report: bias motives across the three periods. Anti-Asian incidents peaked during COVID; anti-Jewish incidents were the most common throughout.

census-data-analysis-detail.alt: Correlation heatmap of income class with age, years of education, race, and sex.
census-data-analysis-detail.caption: Figure 3 from the paper: education (0.34), age (0.23), and sex (0.22) correlate more strongly with income class than race (0.07).

cade-detail.alt: Cade architecture diagram: two boot layers, CLAUDE.md and VAULT-INDEX.md, above the path from boot config to persisted outcome.
cade-detail.caption: From Cade's own documentation: two boot layers feeding one memory system.

flowcast-detail.alt: Flowcast performance dashboard showing actual and predicted pickups, WAPE, MAE, RMSE, and the improvement over the baseline for the selected window.
flowcast-detail.caption: The public performance dashboard: held-out results against the seasonal baseline, filterable by window, horizon, borough, and zone.

contender-detail.alt: Contender homepage: See the numbers behind every pick.
contender-detail.caption: The public homepage at contender.davishiggins.com, which introduces inspectable, saved analyses.

dhlm-detail.alt: DHLM case-study homepage with a synthetic calendar question and a cited answer.
dhlm-detail.caption: The public case study uses a synthetic preview: a calendar question answered with its source marked read-only.

secondchance-detail.alt: SecondChance support queue with filters and open stays showing intake-time estimates and days waiting.
secondchance-detail.caption: The support queue: open stays with intake-time estimates beside actual waits, built on public City of Austin records.

lakeside-sport-club-detail.alt: Lakeside Sport Club collection page with category filters and product cards.
lakeside-sport-club-detail.caption: The Collection page: every piece from the club, filterable by category.
